method.timing: Separate fresh child processes, each one fresh source+phrase owner. Two uninstrumented owners with first/repeated call per query; no discarded warmups. Module imports and fixture generation precede timing. CPU user/system and monotonic wall are distinct. Restore receiver fresh with one prior record.
method.rotation: Normal/diagnostic order cyclically rotated across workload cells; cells reversed in second and third rounds. Sequential processes, no concurrent benchmark work.
method.diagnostics: Only throwaway package copy patched. Diagnostic wall/CPU retained exclusively as intrusive observations, excluded from timing summaries. No guessed overhead subtraction.
method.matching: Independent complete expected membership pinned; measured pages checked for exact total, complete flag, unique eligible finite-score hits. Exact native page scores/order/revisions compared across normal and diagnostic variants. Full corpus ranked membership is not paged exhaustively.
method.scope: Node direct source+source phrases only. Browser/worker/UI configurations Not run; unknown outcome classification is supported but no transport exists in this track. No memory or capacity/performance improvement claim.

source.method: Cycle 34 frozen technical-document sections; retain heading plus a whitespace-bounded excerpt at most 512 UTF-16 code units. Repetitions are labeled and are not independent real documents.
source.limits: Single English technical self-documentation corpus, repeated excerpts and deterministic synthetic lexical controls; no representative traffic or relevance-quality claim.
